datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data at regular monthly intervals throughout 2014 across Mauritania's administrative units. The classifications were spatially encoded as geographic features (GeoJSON/KML) with metadata including collection date, scenario type, and IPC phase assignments to represent food insecurity impact severity.
